units.source_text: 苗子摘下蒙在头上的头巾，说了声“谢谢”，就把脸捂了起来，好大一会儿说不出话。

en.t: Naeko took off the kerchief that had been covering her head, said "thank you," then covered her face and for a long while could not speak.

units.source_text: 我的确是个举目无亲、孤苦伶仃的人，虽然寂寞，但我埋头干活，把这些都忘掉了。”

en.t: I really am a person with no relatives to turn to, lonely and all alone; though I am lonely, I bury myself in work and forget all of that."
